historical_boundaries: The publication on Making Medicines Keep was accepted 15 October 2026; do not present it as already published.
Minhaj al-dukkan is a medieval pharmacy handbook; British Library Or 5786 is a dated 715 AH / AD 1315-16 manuscript witness, not an autograph or proof that the copy was produced in Cairo.
Source materials are documentary evidence of pharmaceutical practice and prescription formulations; they are not measured evidence of contemporary pharmacological efficacy.
An independent generic Wellcome Arabic medical manuscript cannot be represented as a leaf from British Library Or 5786 or a specific Cairo Genizah fragment.
